settings_shareDiagnosticsHint: Help improve the app by uploading anonymized protocol data.
diag_consentBody:
Help improve Open FPV Cast by sending anonymized protocol diagnostics while you are connected to the goggles.

We collect: DUML/protocol frames and camera-command metadata, the app version, and a random anonymous install id.

We never collect video, audio, location, or any personal information. Data is sent securely over HTTPS, and you can turn this off at any time.

bcast_qualityHint: The goggles send 1080p60 at most — these profiles only trade viewer delay for how much of that survives the phone's re-encode.
